Interface IStructureToggleEvent

All Superinterfaces:
IAnimatedArchitectureEvent
All Known Subinterfaces:
IStructureEventToggleEnd, IStructureEventTogglePrepare, IStructureEventToggleStart
All Known Implementing Classes:
StructureEventToggleEnd, StructureEventTogglePrepare, StructureEventToggleStart
public interface IStructureToggleEvent extends IAnimatedArchitectureEvent
Represents an event where a structure is toggled.

The subclasses of this class define the different stages of the toggle event.

Preparation stages can be cancelled, while the start and end stages cannot.

  • Method Details

    • getSnapshot

      StructureSnapshot getSnapshot()
      Before the structure is animated, a snapshot of the data is created which is then used for all calculations.

      The snapshots are read-only, so this snapshot contains the old data of the structure before the animation was applied.

      Returns:
      A snapshot of the structure created at the time the toggle action was requested.

    • getCause

      StructureActionCause getCause()
      Gets what caused the structure action request to be created.
      Returns:
      The cause of the structure action request.

    • getResponsible

      IPlayer getResponsible()
      Gets the UUID of the player responsible for this structure action. This either means the player who directly requested this action or, if it was requested indirectly (e.g. via redstone), the prime owner of the structure. Therefore, this player might not be online.
      Returns:
      The player that is responsible for this event.

    • getTime

      double getTime()
